profile_text.body:
Gamma is a web-based design tool whose site describes it as an "all-in-one AI-powered design partner" for creating presentations, websites, documents, and social media assets without requiring coding or design experience. The platform centers on AI-assisted generation, allowing users to draft and visualize content quickly from within the tool.

Gamma offers a free tier that includes a starter pack of AI credits, with additional credits available by referring other users. Paid plans unlock access to newer AI models, more credits, advanced analytics, custom fonts, and the option to remove the Gamma badge. The company notes that content in Team and Business workspaces is automatically excluded from AI training by default, while content in individual workspaces on Free, Plus, Pro, or Ultra plans may be used for AI training unless the user opts out through account settings.

The site's held facts list one tracked product, Gamma, categorized under Slides and Presentations with a focus on presentation generation. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
